title: ISO 2768-1 general tolerances
description: Checks that the general tolerance class written in the title block can be held by the chosen manufacturing process, and lists the permitted deviations of the overall dimensions.

class.description: ISO 2768-1 class: f (fine), m (medium), c (coarse), v (very coarse).

process.description: Manufacturing process: cnc, sheet_metal, fdm, sla, sls, injection, casting.

rules.citation: ISO 2768-1:1989, Table 1 (permissible deviations for linear dimensions); process capability per DUCAD guideline
rules.note: Tighten only the dimensions that need it; a class the process cannot hold forces secondary operations.
